repos.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy
repos.summary_zh: whistle 是一款基于 Node.js 的跨平台网络抓包与调试代理工具，支持 HTTP、HTTPS、HTTP/2、WebSocket 等协议的抓取与修改。它通过声明式规则引擎和可视化界面，助力开发者高效进行接口联调、Mock 数据与性能排障。
repos.summary_en: Whistle is a cross-platform, Node.js-based network debugging proxy tool designed for capturing and modifying HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, and WebSocket protocols. It features a powerful rule engine, web-based UI, and extensible plugins, enabling developers to efficiently inspect and troubleshoot network requests.

repos.description: 用于在 Heroku 上部署 V2Ray WebSocket。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目实现在Heroku平台一键部署V2Ray WebSocket服务，自动保持最新版本，资源占用合理以避免封号。通过自定义ID和路径增强安全性，并可集成CloudFlare提升性能，适用于快速搭建稳定代理服务的场景。
repos.summary_en: This project enables one-click deployment of V2Ray WebSocket on Heroku, automatically maintaining the latest version with reasonable resource usage to avoid account suspension. It enhances security via custom ID and path, and integrates with CloudFlare for performance improvement, suitable for quickly setting up stable proxy services.

repos.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。
repos.summary_zh: RSSPush 是一款基于 Docker 的 Web 应用，实时监控 RSS 源内容变化，并自动将最新消息推送到微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道。支持 HTTP 代理、关键词过滤、自动翻译等功能，可结合 RSSHub 使用，适用于个人和团队的信息自动化推送场景。
repos.summary_en: RSSPush is a Docker-based web application that monitors RSS feed changes in real-time and automatically pushes the latest content to dozens of messaging channels such as WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. It supports HTTP proxies, keyword filtering, auto-translation, and can integrate with RSSHub, making it ideal for automated information pushing for individuals and teams.

repos.description: 一个功能密度极高的，安装包仅200kb的极致轻量化浏览器
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Android System WebView 的极致轻量隐私浏览器，安装包仅200kb，原生 Java 实现。集成广告拦截、本地加密密码库、用户脚本与离线阅读，零遥测追踪，重塑安全私密的移动浏览体验。
repos.summary_en: An extremely lightweight (only 200kb) privacy-focused Android browser built on System WebView with native Java. Features built-in ad blocking, local encrypted password vault, userscript support, offline reading, and zero telemetry for ultimate privacy.

repos.description: An all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare. Manage Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference & browser rendering visually, with an OpenAI-compatible API for external integration.
repos.summary_zh: CF Manager 是 Cloudflare 多账号统一管理平台，支持 Workers、DNS、存储及 AI 推理的可视化操作。面向多账号开发者与运维人员，解决账号切换与批量操作痛点。技术亮点包括内置 OpenAI 兼容接口与自托管部署，实现本地调试与数据自主控制。
repos.summary_en: CF Manager is an all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare, enabling visual management of Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference, and browser rendering. It is designed for developers and operators with multiple Cloudflare accounts, solving the pain of account switching and batch operations. Key features include an OpenAI-compatible API for local debugging and self-hosted deployment for full data control.
